summary: Iter41 verification of 6 user-reported bugs/features from iter40. Backend suite iter40 (8/8) reruns green. Added 7 new extended tests (test_iter41_extended.py) covering future-date event stays upcoming, mobile-login format variants, quick-add welcome-email path, and also_player E2E. 14/15 passing. One critical E2E gap discovered: /api/players/me still gates on role=='player' and returns 403 for also_player=true users, breaking Feature #4 end-to-end (frontend shows Axios 403 red-screen when admin/HR/organiser navigates to /players/me after opting in).

critical.issue: Backend gate `user.role != 'player'` returns 403 even when `also_player=true`. Frontend PlayerProfile.jsx already widened its route guard to allow also_player users; backend must match. Response body: {"detail":"Player only"}. This breaks the whole Feature #4 UX (Uncaught AxiosError overlay).

ui_bugs.issue: Route allows also_player user in, then GET /api/players/me returns 403 → dev overlay 'Uncaught runtime errors: Request failed with status code 403'. Add try/catch around the fetch OR wait for backend fix.

Banner is intentionally hidden for `isPlatformAdmin` (`!isPlatformAdmin` guard on line 209). Review request expected platform admin to see the banner too; either update banner condition OR update review expectation. Currently the banner will only show for HR/company_admin/organiser roles — none of which have documented QA credentials in test_credentials.md, so this UI cannot be exercised end-to-end in preview.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend allows navigation to /players/me for also_player users but backend rejects the API call → dev-overlay error. See critical backend issue above.

action_items: Widen backend guard in /app/backend/server.py::get_my_player_profile (line 1716) and update_my_profile (line 1726) to allow `user.get('also_player') is True` in addition to `role == 'player'`. Resolve player_profile_id from the user document when role != 'player'.
Optional: decide whether platform_admin should see the also-player banner in Admin.jsx (currently hidden by `!isPlatformAdmin`).
Optional: create a seeded HR/organiser QA account with documented password so the also-player UI banner + badge can be exercised end-to-end in preview.

rca of the issue: Feature #4 (HR/organiser opt-in as also-player) shipped iter40 with the frontend gates widened (PlayerProfile.jsx line 65 and AuthContext.isPlayer) and a new /auth/also-player endpoint, but the /api/players/me GET+PATCH endpoints (server.py 1716-1744) were NOT updated to accept also_player users. Reproduction: login admin@kreedanation.com/admin123 → POST /api/auth/also-player {enabled:true} (200) → GET /api/auth/me returns also_player=true & player_profile_id → GET /api/players/me returns 403 'Player only'. Frontend PlayerProfile.jsx navigates in based on the widened gate but the axios.get('/players/me') then throws, popping the dev-mode red overlay. Fix: change `if user.get('role') != 'player'` to `if user.get('role') != 'player' and not user.get('also_player')` in both endpoints, and when also_player is set, look up profile by `user['player_profile_id']` (already stored on the user doc by toggle_also_player).
